title: Quoting Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang
content: We think "did a human read the code?" is an imprecise proxy for "what could go wrong with this change, and which check—automated or human—is the right one to catch it?" Asking that question also changed when review happens. Before, review was a gate at the end of the road: write the code, open a PR, wait for your colleague. Now, review runs continuously, more like spellcheck while you write. Most changes have been reviewed and fixed by Claude at least once before a human is asked to look. This catches most routine mistakes, and saves team attention for higher-level questions and scrutiny. — Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang , How the Claude Code team does code review Tags: anthropic , claude , ai , claude-code , llms , addy-osmani , coding-agents , generative-ai , agentic-engineering , code-review
summary_zh: 引用 Claude Code 团队关于代码审查的文章：他们认为“是否有人读过代码”只是个粗略的替代指标，真正该问的是“这次改动可能出什么问题，用哪种检查（自动或人工）最适合发现它”。审查因此从 PR 末端的关卡，变成像拼写检查一样边写边持续进行。大多数改动在交给人看之前，已经被 Claude 审查并修复过至少一次，常规错误基本在这一步被拦下，团队的注意力可以留给更高层次的问题。

title: Tree Appreciator
content: Tool: Tree Appreciator Another game experiment with Claude. This one used the default Claude iPhone app (chat mode, not Claude Code mode), where I prompted Claude Opus 5.5 Max with: Build a three js game called "Tree appreciator" - it shows you two algorithmically generated trees and the game mechanics is about appreciating the differences between them. Think hard about how to make sure it is both fun and beautiful. Somewhat embarrassingly given my recent talk , I've found that telling Opus 5.5 "make sure it is fun" works uncomfortably well. In this case Claude crunched for 3 hours and 7 minutes before retuning a cosy little spot-the-difference game with music and animation and achievements that's quite compelling to play.
summary_zh: Simon Willison 用 Claude iPhone 应用的普通聊天模式（不是 Claude Code）让 Opus 5.5 Max 生成了一个 three.js 小游戏「Tree Appreciator」。玩家在两棵程序生成的树之间找不同。模型连续运行了 3 小时 7 分钟，交付的成品带音乐、动画和成就系统。文中提到一个提示技巧：在提示词里直接要求“确保好玩”，效果出奇地好。

title: Chirp Pong
content: Tool: Chirp Pong Another game experiment - I wanted to see if it was feasible to have a two player game on two separate phones running in static HTML where the networking code uses chirps sent via the microphone. It seems to work! Build a two player competitive pong like game where two players use their phones close to each other and the game state is sent via audio noises which the web microphone API can interpret - but add graphical and gameplay twists to make it a lot more fun and intertwine than pong Claude Opus 5.5 Extra in Claude Code . Tags: game-design , ai , generative-ai , llms , claude-code
summary_zh: Simon Willison 用一句提示词，让 Claude Code（Claude Opus 5.5 Extra）生成了一个双人对战游戏 Chirp Pong。游戏是纯静态 HTML，两部手机之间不走网络，而是靠麦克风 API 收发音频啁啾声来同步游戏状态。这个案例说明 AI 编程工具能快速验证非常规的技术想法，但文章只有原始提示词和结果，没有讲具体的工作流或技巧。

title: LaTeX renderer
content: Tool: LaTeX renderer Inspired by Paul Ford and Aboard Foundary's new web app Tiny Little Office , which provides a suite of web app content editors (a Word Processor, Outliner, Presentation Builder, Spreadsheet, Calculator, Drawing Tool, Diagram Maker, Animator, Calendar, and Trip Planner). Tiny Little Office's signature trick is to store all of the document data in the #fragment section of the URL, so every document created using it becomes a bookmarkable and shareable link. It also has an llms.txt file telling agents how to construct URLs that will render as documents. Claude used that file to generate
summary_zh: Simon Willison 受 Paul Ford 的 Tiny Little Office 启发，用 Claude 做了一个 LaTeX 渲染小工具。Tiny Little Office 把文档数据全部存在 URL 的 #fragment 里，每份文档都能直接收藏和分享，还提供 llms.txt 告诉 AI 智能体如何拼出能渲染成文档的 URL。Claude 正是读了这个 llms.txt 来生成工具的，说明 llms.txt 能帮助智能体理解和使用 Web 应用。
